notes.title: deadHex Now on Steam Playtest!
notes.content:
PLAYTEST SCHEDULE - US-WEST (All Times PST):
Friday - Sunday 7PM - 11PM

One rotating weekday 7PM - 11PM (Announced on our Discord and game client every week).

Grab a friend, queue up, and face off in 1v1 tactical FPS-MOBA combat.


WHAT'S NEW THIS BUILD
New map: Ballroom, a vertical battlefield that promotes intense duels and is perfect for mind games.

Blitz Game Mode: Our new game mode that has shorter rounds, faster power spikes, and a curated list of Artifacts that show what deadHex is about.  Perfect for newcomers and veterans alike!

Balance + Bugfixes: Improved game flow, expanded build expression, and a ton of under-the-hood polish.


HELP SHAPE THE DEADHEX
deadHex is still in development, and your input shapes what comes next.  Found a bug?  A build you think is broken?  A moment that felt incredible?  We'd love to know!  Your feedback is invaluable to making deadHex the best game it can be.  


WHAT'S NEXT?
If all goes well, we'll be expanding our server up time and regions.  We're looking towards your feedback to incorporate things like a tutorial, spectator system, and replay system.  Until then, we hope you’ll help us test, tune, and shape the future of deadHex.

Thanks for playing.  We’ll see you in the Hamlet.
